name: Elliahal: Chronicles of the Bloomspell
source:
Elliahal: Chronicles of the Bloomspell is a story-driven adult fantasy game centered on immersion, vulnerability, and power dynamics. It blends branching scenes, first-person sequences, layered visuals, character development, and time-based progression to build an expanding world focused on atmosphere and narrative tension.

You play as Aelara, an elven princess with traits that may prove to be either a blessing or a curse.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/elliahal-of-153115545]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Elliahal: Chronicles of the Bloomspell》是一款故事驱动的成人奇幻游戏，以沉浸感、脆弱性和权力动态为中心。它融合了分支场景、第一人称序列、分层视觉效果、角色发展和基于时间的进程，构建了一个注重氛围和叙事张力的不断扩展的世界。

你扮演艾拉拉（Aelara），一位精灵公主，她的特质要么是祝福，要么是诅咒。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/elliahal-of-153115545]Patreon[/url]]
